name: IKS Inquisitor
_comment: R3.55, Module R3 SSD book printed page 17 (PDF 18). Corner reads YS:175 DK:6 EX:17 CR:6, and
Annex #1 agrees on both numbers that appear in two places: explosion strength 17, BPV 100.
The D5 hull issued to the Internal Security Forces, and the sheet says in so many words what
that costs: 'THE D5I ASSIGNED TO THE INTERNAL SECURITY FORCES HAD INFERIOR FIRE CONTROL TO
THOSE SHIPS IN THE DEEP SPACE FLEET.' Three concrete things carry that, and all three are
easy to lose by copying the D5:
- the FORWARD phasers are PHASER-2s, where the D5 mounts phaser-1s;
- the disruptors are RANGE 22. The disruptor table on the sheet stops at the 16-22 column,
where the D5's runs to 30. Checked against the printed table, not inferred;
- NO DERFACS. The D5 declares it; this hull does not get it.
It carries no UIM either, like the D5 and unlike the D5N.
Everything else IS the D5, verified box by box rather than assumed: shields 30/26 x5, front
hull 3 and rear hull 6, warp 12+12, impulse 4+1 emergency, APR 2, batteries 3, three
transporters, three tractors, two shuttle boxes, sensor 6-5-3-1-0, scanner 0-1-3-5-9, damage
control 4-2-2-2-0 and four excess boxes.
Smaller complement than the D5: 36 crew units against 40, and six boarding parties against
eight. An internal-security ship does not carry a boarding force.
One oddity recorded rather than smoothed over: the corner gives YS:175 and the data table
also lists a Y175 refit, so the window in which this ship has type-A racks is empty in
practice. The sheet still states the conversion, so it is modelled as printed.
_y175Comment: The sheet states the conversion outright: 'SHIP HAD TYPE-A DRONE RACKS (ONE RELOAD) UNTIL THE
Y175 REFIT, WHICH CONVERTED THESE TO TYPE-B DRONE RACKS (2 RELOADS).' The racks are therefore
named explicitly here rather than left to the faction default, which a bare refitCost block
The ADDs need no entry: 'ANTI-DRONES ALWAYS HAD 12 ROUNDS', so they are born ADD_12 and the
universal ADD_6 to ADD_12 conversion has nothing to do.
